- Smoke-checked: `/`, `/essays/`, `/receipts/`, `/js/highlights.js` all 200; `/docs/` correctly 404 (excluded via `.vercelignore`)

**Two things worth your attention:**

1. **`docs/wiki/` was excluded from the deploy.** Your working tree had a large auto-generated `docs/wiki/` folder (session transcripts, research notes, citations) that got committed to git but I added it to `.vercelignore` so it isn't served publicly at f7z.io — seemed like internal notes, not site content. Say the word if you actually want it public.
